messages:
elaine: FYI CI size gate just failed on the attention kernel experiment, looks like the fatbin grew ~18MB.

matt: ugh, thanks for flagging. which build matrix row?

elaine: x86_64/cuda12.2/gcc12/ptx+fatbin. build log: `artifacts/runtime-fatbin.tar.gz` is 98MB vs baseline 80MB.

raj: probably because we started shipping cubin for all -gencode arch entries instead of PTX fallback. nvcc --generate-code flags can produce cubins per sm.

sasha: can we change CI to split PTX-only and CUBIN artifacts? PTX is forward-compatible, cubin is per-arch and explodes size.

kevin: +1. Also consider stripping debug symbols from fatbin: `nvcc ... -Xcompiler -s` or post-process with `cuobjdump`/`fatbin-converter`? not all are reliable.

elaine: tried `--ptx` only build but then runtime falls back slower for some optimized kernels. The new attention kernels include multiple variants tuned per sm, so PTX-only loses perf.

matt: tradeoff: small artifact vs perf. For CI we only need size check and correctness; we can build two artifacts: `runtime-ptx.tar.gz` (small) for size gate and `runtime-full.tar.gz` for perf/regression. CI can gate on the PTX artifact for size and run perf tests against full.

raj: implementation detail: adjust CMake toolchain to add `-gencode=arch=compute_70,code=compute_70` for PTX artifact and `-gencode=arch=compute_70,code=sm_70` for full. Or use `-rdc=true` split-link to reduce duplicates.

sasha: also consider `-Xptxas -O3 -Xptxas -dlcm=ca` flags for kernel perf; but these can change obj size unpredictably. We should keep a whitelist of safe ptxas flags for CI.

olga: buildcop: propose new CI job: `kernel-size-smoke` that builds PTX-only for all archs and fails if > 85MB. Another job `kernel-full` for perf runs but excluded from size gate.

buildcop: auto-approve: created ticket INF-672: add kernel-size-smoke, PTX artifact and size thresholds. Tagging @eng-runtime.

kevin: quick mitigation: strip symbol tables from fatbin with `~/tools/fatbin-strip.py` in the interim. Also enable `ccache` for nvcc to speed CI.

elaine: I'll push a draft PR with CMake changes and CI job. pinging @matt @raj for review. thanks :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deploybot: scheduled build #4821 for branch attention-kernels (size-smoke)

matt: thanks. If PR changes arch list, please add a changelog note for the binary size watchers.

elaine: will do.
